applicant_utility.summary: Around 100 scholarships of €10,000 a year gross plus a tuition-fee exemption, awarded automatically to the best applicant on each English-taught Milano-Bicocca programme at roughly five awards per course, with no separate form to fill in. Because selection rides entirely on the admission ranking and priority goes to candidates who applied in the first Call for Admission, the timing of your admission application matters more than any supplementary statement. Non-EU applicants must additionally hold the Italian student visa and be present in Milan by the enrolment date, so the award and your ability to take it up are separate hurdles.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving applicants seeking a bachelor's, master's or single-cycle degree taught in English at Milano-Bicoccca who can apply in the first admission call and who are not currently living in Italy.
application_readiness_checklist: Apply in the first Call for Admission, because priority for the five awards per course goes to those candidates
Confirm your programme is one of the courses taught in English, since those are the only ones with BISP allocations
Diary the enrolment confirmation date (15 March 2026 for open-access programmes) as your real deadline, not a scholarship deadline
If your programme is a restricted-access programme, complete every admission step and confirm the offer within the specified deadline
If you need a visa, apply early enough to be in Milan by the enrolment date, since presence in Milan is an enrolment condition
common_rejection_risks: Applying after the first Call for Admission and losing the priority that first-call candidates receive
Currently residing in Italy, which disqualifies you outright
Failing to be included in the official admission list, or failing to confirm the offer or enrolment by the specified deadline
Holding a benefit granted through another call, since applicants may only benefit from one scholarship per academic year
Not being able to obtain the Italian student visa or be in Milan for the enrolment date, which blocks the award
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs in Milan or one of the campuses, the visa and permit costs, and travel, none of which the BISP award addresses.
document_audit: No separate scholarship application file exists, so the admission file is evaluated for both admission and funding
Dual citizenship, including joint Italian citizenship, does not rule you out - this is an unusual and generous feature of the BISP rules
The page publishes rankings and a call for applications last updated 16/07/2026, so check the call for the evaluation and award rules
alerts: The five awards per course are roughly symmetric, so the effective cut-off is being top of your course rather than an absolute grade threshold
Non-EU students must be able to obtain the student visa and be in Milan by the specified date, so start the visa process before the ranking is out

applicant_utility.summary: Bocconi's Right to University Education award for first-year students, combining a variable cash stipend with a free daily meal valued at €829 for 2026-27, preferential canteen rates and a 200-hour work-study programme. The cash amount is the deliberate unknown here: it is set each year by the Lombardy Region and depends on your ISU bracket, your student status and whether you are fuori corso, so no figure is published for 2027-28 yet. For international applicants the practical reality is a short, fixed window tied to your admission session, with the ISEE or ISEEU Parificato documentation usually deciding the outcome.
applicant_utility.best_fit: First-year international applicants to a Bocconi Bachelor of Science, Integrated Master of Arts in Law or Master of Science whose family income sits near the published ISEE and ISPE thresholds and who can gather Italian-equivalent economic documents in time.
application_readiness_checklist: Identify which international admission session you are applying through and note its window, since the scholarship window is that window
For Early Session international applicants, diarise the CAF confirmation by email for 12:00 noon on 26 November 2026 and the corrected ISEEU Parificato date of 11 January 2027
Obtain the ISEE or ISEEU Parificato and ISPE or ISPEEU Parificato, using the Italian consulate or designated CAF if your documents are foreign
Ensure every document carries a handwritten signature matching the identity document uploaded with your admission application
Prepare the documents evidencing your non-resident status, which international applicants are explicitly required to upload
Watch for the email on document completeness by 30 September 2027 and the provisional ranking by mid-October 2027
common_rejection_risks: Applying outside the window for your admission session, since the scholarship application is tied to that session
A CAF not confirmed by 26 November 2026 for Early Session candidates, or a defective ISEEU Parificato that is not corrected by 11 January 2027
Documents signed in a way that does not match the identity document uploaded at admission, which invalidates the file
Applying to a Master of Fine Arts program, which is excluded, or applying as an absolute first-year in anything other than the regular year
For renewal, failing to earn at least 44 credits by 10 August 2028 for BSc and Law, or 39 credits for Lifelong Learning and Master of Science
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition fees, which are not part of this award: for first-year Bocconi and Italian applicants, fee and tuition benefits are assigned through the separate Bocconi4Access to Education a.y. 2027-28 application. Also accommodation in Milan and travel.
document_audit: The economic documentation is the decisive element: the ISEE or ISEEU Parificato must not exceed €26,887.93 and the ISPE or ISPEEU Parificato must not exceed €58,452.06 on the a.y. 2026-27 tables
The scholarship amount will not include the regional tax for the right to university education
Payment is made in two instalments, the second only after the credits earned by 10 August are verified, and not before October 2028 for first-year recipients who meet the requirement
The application is not automatically granted each year: renewal requires a new application
alerts: Provisional rankings come out by mid-October 2027 and final rankings only by the end of October 2027, so first-semester funding is uncertain
The number of stipends awarded depends on the funds available from the Lombardy Region, so there is no fixed quota
The pages are flagged as being updated and the final application requirements and regulations for a.y. 2027-28 are expected only by the end of October 2026
The daily meal entitlement rises in proportion if the number of meals consumed is greater, and is slashed for fuori corso enrolment
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply in your international admission session window, confirm the CAF and submit economic and non-residence documents, receive feedback on completeness by 30 September 2027, then check the provisional ranking by mid-October and the final ranking by the end of October 2027.
